Presentation grouping: source is presented under target in a statement tree; asserts co-presentation, not algebra. Evidence tier below calculation arcs; never derivation proof.

One transaction coordinate stated in two naming dialects: a payments coordinate (source) and a purchase coordinate (target). Ladder bridge entry only; asserts no algebra. Entry requires the purchase act on the purchase side and a payments side equal to the edge's declared source coordinate, carrying neither the purchase act nor a sale marker (M_PURPOSE_SALE / M_SALES_GOODS, the markers sale/sales-worded proceeds lines carry).
